reason: I already reorder my Toplux when it runs out and I have a drawer full of half-used bottles. I don't need another supplement, and I'm not swapping something I already take for two capsules every night.
objection: Two capsules a day is a chore, and I already own too many bottles I don't finish. $30 a month for something I'd probably quit after two weeks.
would_change_my_mind: A free or very cheap one-box trial, or a single capsule a day instead of two.
